comments.author: @giannisolga5191
comments.text: This video is amazing. What an astonishing discovery, that there was an entire civilisation along the banks of the Amazon which vanished. In the 1970s a friend offered me the opportunity to go up the Amazon to test a hovercraft he had designed for the Brazilian Amazon Police. I read up all I could (the deal fell through and I didn't go). But the sources indicated nobody lived there. Thanks to you I now know that European viruses had wiped out 99% of the population and the river reclaimed the land, but leaving the terra preta as telltale evidence. I saw the opera Florencia en el Amazonas, about an opera singer going to an opera house in Manaus. I thought that was far-fetched and absurd - an opera house in the middle of the Amazon.. I've certainly been put in my place. I had no idea that all the world's rubber originally came from the Amazon. The cruelty of the Peruvian Amazon Company is shocking. Horrifying that the 'lost recluse' peoples are refugees from maltreatment of the rubber workers. Shocking and shameful but edifying. I have a friend from Iquietas and it was fun to see his hometown. That oceangoing boats can penetrate so far amazed me. What remarkable pictures of the Rio Negro and Rio Solemoes side by side. That there are no mosquitoes on the Rio Negro because of acidity! I learned so much on this adventure. Thank you.
